materialChange: The current authenticated Adobe connector now resolves the preserved Desk9 Firefly generation record to a time-limited download URL in addition to its rendition/preview URL. This closes the prior uncertainty about whether an authenticated download endpoint can be obtained for the preserved generation URN. The current automation runtime still cannot materialize that endpoint as an exact file: the container cannot resolve the Adobe short-link host, the non-interactive browser path requires user interaction, and the Adobe inline-preview path renders pixels for inspection rather than returning a repository-stageable original byte stream. No candidate bytes were imported or changed.

probe.note: The presigned URL token is intentionally not persisted because it is ephemeral. A rendered preview, screenshot, re-encode, resized output, or extracted approximation is not accepted as source bytes. The remote Firefly record is a DCX generation asset and carries no raw output-image hash claim, so no equivalence to the preserved local PNG source may be assumed without byte-level proof.

handoff.reason: No repository-staged exact source bytes exist.

exactMissingPrerequisite: A byte-preserving authorized bridge that can materialize either one preserved 1254x1254 local Desk8/9/10 source file or the authenticated Desk9/10 Firefly generation output into the execution filesystem without rendering/re-encoding, followed by byte count, SHA-256, dimensions/decode, Git blob and repository readback verification. For Firefly DCX records, the bridge must also prove the materialized output bytes correspond to the preserved selected image rather than a rendition or newly encoded export.
